title: Amazon catalog discovery: per-site config
description: Config for agents/amazon-catalog-discovery-agent. It is the whole file named by CATALOG_DISCOVERY_CONFIG, or the `catalog_discovery` block of a larger site.yaml. Every niche value (lanes, seeds, browse nodes, price partitions, reject rules, seed sources) lives here; the engine code names no site and no niche. Keys starting with '_' are comments. catalog_discovery/config.py adds the checks a schema cannot express (regexes compile, ids are unique, references resolve, SQL templates use only the parameters the engine supplies).

site.description: Site-registry name (framework.core.site_registry). Used to resolve the catalog DSN env var when catalog.dsn_env is not set, and as a label.

enabled.description: false = every run returns at once without touching the DB or the API. Default true.

consumer.description: Creators budget line every searchItems call is charged to (config/amazon-creators-budget.json shares), e.g. '<site>-discovery'.

partner_tag.description: Associate tag for the API calls (not a secret). Wins over partner_tag_env.

partner_tag_env.description: Env var holding the associate tag. Default: AMAZON_CREATORS_PARTNER_TAG.

max_item_page.description: Highest itemPage to request. Creators refuses itemPage 11+, so a config may lower this ceiling but never raise it (the engine also clamps to 10). Default 10.

result_count_cap.description: Value at which Creators clips totalResultCount (306 as measured). A count below it is exact; at it, the list length is unknown.

price_filter_unit.description: Unit of the minPrice/maxPrice search filters. Creators takes CENTS (verified by the 2026-11-12 sizing run: 1,005 of 1,016 priced items on banded pages fell inside their band). The engine still counts listings outside their band (partition_price_misses) as a regression guard. Default cents.

max_calls_per_run.description: searchItems calls per run (also capped by the consumer's remaining daily budget). Default 40.

max_new_per_run.description: New in-lane ASINs persisted per run from search. Default 300.

max_pages_per_query.description: Deepest itemPage per query (at most creators.max_item_page, itself at most 10). Default 10.

max_seed_asins_per_run.description: Seed ASINs inserted per run across all seed sources. Default 5000.

stop_if_new_in_lane_below.description: Low-yield stop (the sizing run's stop_if_new_inlane_lt): a page at or past low_yield_from_page that adds fewer new in-lane ASINs than this ends its query for the cycle (end reason 'low-yield'). 0 = off (default).

low_yield_from_page.description: First itemPage the low-yield stop applies to. Default 2 (page 1 of every query is always followed by page 2).

protect_consumers.description: Consumers whose unspent daily share is reserved: this run never spends into the day total they still need (local stand-in for the reserved floor W3 adds to amazon_creators).

keep_unused_fraction_of_day.description: Fraction of total_calls_per_day this run must leave unused. Default 0.

min_price.description: Pricing-integrity floor applied by amazon_discovery.listing_rejection: no $0 or sub-$1 offer is ever accepted, so a config may raise it, never lower it below 1. Default 1.0.

require_new_condition.description: Reject listings whose only offer is not New. Default true.

dsn_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the catalog DSN. Default: the site registry's dsn_env for `site`.

asin_regex.description: ASINs that do not match are never persisted. Default ^B[0-9A-Z]{9}$.

site_id.description: Value bound to %(site_id)s, for catalogs keyed by site.

known_sql.description: Returns the ASIN (first column) of every row the catalog already carries among %(asins)s (a text[] of ASINs). Only %(asins)s may be used.

insert_sql.description: Persists one ASIN. Named parameters only, from: asin, lane, lane_kind, lane_category, confidence, via, seed, run_ts, site_id. No Amazon content is ever bound. rowcount 1 = inserted, 0 = already there.

active_phases.description: Lanes whose `phase` is not listed are held back: their seeds are not searched and listings classified into them are not persisted. Absent = every phase is active.

reject_patterns.description: Global title rejects, applied before any lane, to search listings AND to every seed record that has a title. A listing that matches one is never inserted by search; a titled seed record that matches one is never imported. Seed records without a title cannot be screened, so a source imports their labels only for lanes it lists under `lanes` or with `trust_labels: true`. Catalog rows whose fresh search title hits one are reported (known_now_rejected). Year-1 safety boundaries (e.g. cords a site must not carry) belong here, not in a lane's `exclude`: precedence can file a listing in an earlier lane before a later lane's exclude is tried.

measures.description: Numbers read from listing titles (e.g. a capacity), referenced by lane `measures` rules.

lanes.description: Our own product classes, in PRECEDENCE order: a listing takes the first lane whose rules it passes; failing one lane's rules falls through to the next.

cycle_cooldown_hours.description: After every query reached its end, wait this long before re-scanning from page 1. Default 0.

golden.description: Operator-labelled ASINs: ASIN -> expected lane id or 'reject'. Our own labels only.

golden_file.description: JSON object of the same shape (merged under `golden`), relative to this config file.

window.description: Golden observations kept across runs. Default 500.

min_observations.description: Precision metrics are reported once this many observations back them. Default 10.

confidence.description: Value bound to %(confidence)s by the evidence behind a lane label. Defaults 0.9 / 0.7 / 0.6, and 0.8 for seed imports.

enabled.description: Run the match phase after seeds and search, in the same run (same consumer, budget and run lock). Default false.

max_calls_per_run.description: Creators calls (getItems + searchItems) the match phase may make per run, on top of limits.max_calls_per_run, and never more than the consumer's remaining daily share (with budget.protect_consumers reserved). Default 20.

confidence.description: A link needs a matcher confidence at least this high, and this value is what link_sql binds as %(confidence)s (the product's category_confidence). Default 0.9.

brand_aliases.description: Maker name as models_sql returns it -> other spellings of Amazon's brand field (byLineInfo.brand), e.g. {"Maker": ["MAKER INC"]}. Case, spacing and punctuation already fold together.

kind_roles.description: Model kind -> matcher role (station, kit, panel, battery, other). Default: station, kit, panel and battery (also expansion / expansion_battery) by name; anything else 'other'.

compatible_kinds.description: Product kind (the lane's kind) -> model kinds it may be linked to. A product kind not listed may only take a model of the same kind. Omit to skip the check.

capacity_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance when a capacity (Wh) or wattage (W) stated in the title is compared with the model's rated value. Default 0.03.

models_sql.description: ONE read-only SELECT of every model (no parameters). Columns by name: id, brand, model_name, kind (required); aliases, model_number, brand_aliases, capacity_wh, power_w, components, component_qty (kit component model ids and quantities), priority (lower first; NULL last), linked (has an active product), searchable (model-first may search it; default true), variants (documented variants: links per run = max(1, variants)).

candidates_sql.description: ONE read-only SELECT (no parameters) of the products ASIN-first checks: `asin` and optionally `kind`, e.g. active products with no model. It runs as a subquery in keyset pages (`asin > <cursor> ORDER BY asin`).

link_sql.description: The UPDATE that links a product to a model. Named parameters from asin, model_id, confidence, rule, run_ts only, and it must keep `model_id IS NULL` in its WHERE so an existing link is never overwritten.

stats_sql.description: Optional ONE read-only SELECT returning one row with `active_products` and `matched_products` (feeds products_model_matched_pct).

batch.description: ASINs per getItems call (Creators allows 10). Default 10.

max_calls.description: getItems calls per run (the rest of the allowance goes to model-first). Default: the whole allowance.

recheck_hours.description: Once every candidate was checked, start over after this long. Default 168.

queries_per_run.description: searchItems calls (one per model) per run. Default 20.

retry_hours.description: A model searched without a link is searched again after this long. Default 168.

model_matching.description: ASIN-to-model matching ('search and confirm'): links products to the site's own models with framework.core.model_matcher. Amazon's title and brand are read in memory at match time and never stored; only the ASIN, model id, rule id, confidence and time persist.

partition.description: [low, high) price band in dollars; null = open end.

dot_thousands.description: Read '1.024' (one digit, dot, three digits) as 1024 for THIS pattern. Only valid on an unscaled pattern: '1.024Wh' is 1024 Wh, but '3.072kWh' is 3072 Wh, not 3,072,000.

patterns.description: Regexes whose group 1 is the number; `scale` multiplies it (e.g. 1000 for kWh -> Wh).

strip.description: Removed from the title before matching (e.g. 'expandable to 6kWh').

pick.description: Which match wins: leftmost (default), largest or smallest.

dot_thousands.description: Default for the measure's UNSCALED patterns only (scale 1); a scaled pattern never reads '3.072' as 3072. Prefer the per-pattern key.

missing_min_price.description: When the title states no value, the listing must cost at least this much.

required.description: When the title states no value, the lane does not match.

browse_node.description: Search scope. Absent = the lane's search_browse_node; null = unscoped.

min_price.description: Floor for NEW listings found by this seed (amazon_discovery keyword floor). It can only raise pricing.min_price, never lower it.

partitions.description: Absent = the lane's price_partitions; false = one unpartitioned query.

id.description: Our lane label, persisted with the ASIN (%(lane)s).

category.description: %(lane_category)s (e.g. the site's category slug). Default: the lane id.

enabled.description: false = held back like an inactive phase (still used for precedence).

browse_nodes.description: Amazon browse nodes whose listings belong to this lane (evidence; see `match`).

search_browse_node.description: Default browseNodeId filter for this lane's seeds. Default none.

match.description: Positive evidence required: title rules, a browse-node hit, both, or either. Default 'title' when include rules exist, else 'node'.

include_all.description: Every regex must match the title.

include_any.description: At least one regex must match the title.

exclude.description: Any match moves the listing on to the next lane.

context_required.description: At least one must match, else the listing moves on (e.g. a cable lane that needs a niche word).

price_partitions.description: Each seed is searched once per band (minPrice/maxPrice filters), so a lane larger than one query's 100 reachable results can be enumerated.

laneMap.description: The source's own lane labels -> our lane ids (e.g. a sizing run's 'expansion_battery' -> 'expansion'). Labels not listed are used as they are.

path.description: JSON file, relative to this config file. Shapes: [asin, ...], [{asin, lane?, phase?, ...}], {asin: lane}, {asin: {lane?, ...}}.

json_path.description: Dotted path to the ASIN container inside the file (e.g. 'asins').

title_field.description: Field holding a title to screen each record with (global rejects, held-back lanes, the lane's own excludes). Read in memory, never stored.

where.description: Keep a record only when every field holds the given value (or one of a list of accepted values).

where_not.description: Drop a record when any field holds the given value (or one of a list of values).

lanes.description: Only these lanes are imported from this source. For records WITHOUT a title it is also the trust list: their lane labels are used only for the lanes listed here (or with trust_labels).

trust_labels.description: Use the lane labels of untitled records for every lane, not only the ones under `lanes`. Default false: an untitled label cannot be checked against the lane rules or the year-1 rejects.

default_lane.description: Lane for records that carry none (the operator's own assertion).

confidence.description: Value bound to %(confidence)s for this source's rows, instead of confidence.seed / the classifier's (e.g. below a site's pick floor for labels nobody has re-screened).

site.description: Site-registry name of the database to read (DSN from its dsn_env).

dsn_env.description: NAME of the env var with the DSN. Use a SELECT-only database role.

sql.description: ONE read-only SELECT (no ';' except one at the end) returning `asin` and optionally `lane`, `phase` and `title` columns. It runs as a subquery, in keyset pages of max_rows (`asin > <cursor> ORDER BY asin`), in a session with default_transaction_read_only=on. `title` is used in memory to screen or classify the row and is never stored.

lanes.description: Only these lanes are imported; for untitled rows also the trust list (see seedFile.lanes).

classify_titles.description: Let the lane rules pick each titled row's lane (a `lane` column that disagrees skips the row). Default false: the label or default_lane is kept, after the title passes the global rejects and the lane's own excludes.

refresh_hours.description: Re-run the query at most this often once it was read to its end. Default 168.

max_rows.description: Rows per keyset page (one page per run; a full page continues next run). Default 5000.
